{{Short description|American mathematician}}
'''Geoffrey K. Martin '''is a [[mathematician]] currently advising in the field of [[mathematical physics]].  Martin is also the Associate Professor and Chair of the mathematics department at the [[University of Toledo]].  His fields of study include [[differential geometry]], [[theory of relativity|relativity]], and the foundations of [[physics]].  Martin earned his Ph.D. at the [[Stony Brook University]] in 1983. Geoffrey is the son of horticulturists Joy Lee Martin and Ernest Martin who owned Logee's Greenhouses.
